episodes.synopsis: DCI Jeanette Kilburn hunts a killer, leading her to Dr. Sophia Craven.
episodes.title: She Sees Herself from Above

episodes.synopsis: Another body gives Jeanette new leads, while Sophia is haunted by a patient.
episodes.title: The Egg She Wishes to Crack

episodes.synopsis: Jeanette comes under fire. Madeleine is in danger as Victoria gets closer.
episodes.title: She Wishes to Believe

episodes.synopsis: A cold case shifts Jeanette's focus, as Sophia gets some distressing news.
episodes.title: The Dirt She Can't Bury

episodes.synopsis: Jeanette and Sophia dig into Victoria's past. Madeleine plans her escape.
episodes.title: She Shoots for the King

episodes.synopsis: Jeanette turns to Sophia as her world begins to crumble Victoria seeks revenge.
episodes.title: I'll See You There

episodes.synopsis: As DCI Jeanette Kilburn navigates her new relationship with Dr. Sophia Craven, a horrifying discovery at a pig farm brings new insight to the investigation. Meanwhile, an accident at a local church reveals a chilling buried secret.
episodes.title: We Are Many

episodes.synopsis: Sophia gives a statement to the police. Jeanette fears that Victoria may target Beecham College headmaster Peter Drake and attempts to bring him into protective custody. Mike, at the mortuary, makes a surprising discovery.
episodes.title: Amor Fati

episodes.synopsis: Sophia worries that Victoria's memories are bleeding into her own. Jeanette and Mike identify the body in the crypt and, seeking answers, visit Peter Drake. A new witness comes forward with shocking revelations as Victoria seeks answers from Mary.
episodes.title: Into the Light

episodes.synopsis: Jeanette and Mike identify the girl from the freezer, leading them to the care home's owner. Meanwhile, officers make a discovery that provides new insight into a suspect as Sophia continues to experience Victoria's memories.
episodes.title: Divide and Conquer

episodes.synopsis: As Victoria issues a chilling ultimatum, a shaken Sophia leaves a message for Jeanette. Meanwhile, David goes on the run after CCTV places him at Mary's murder site, and mounting evidence forces Jeanette to question Sophia herself.
episodes.title: Swan Song

episodes.synopsis: With her career hanging in the balance, Jeanette returns to police HQ determined to solve the case before Verity removes her. A discovery from Sophia's flat reveals old secrets and new connections that tie the crimes together.
episodes.title: Alma Mater
